sn47.19:1.1: This may be modern Sambalpur in Odisha, near the bay of Bengal. 500km to the east lies Chandraketugarh, where the earliest physical evidence for pole acrobatics or *mallakambha* has been found. One pot from around 200 BCE shows, in detailed and graceful style, three acrobats using a T-shaped pole. One man kneels, holding the pole with great strength and balance, while a man and a woman perform acrobatics on opposite bars of the T. A crowd of women and men look on in amazement.
sn47.19:1.3: This appears to be the oldest reference to pole dancing, knows as mallakambha https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mallakhamba
